motivation: The earlier 80-update ovule_budget=3 synthetic pilot showed K8 terminal occupancy 0/48 in every gate; a complete fixed coarse grid is needed to diagnose floor/ceiling rather than choose a favorable result.
inference_unit: single specified hand-authored environmental history for each regime; demographic RNG replicates are nested and cannot give independent ecological uncertainty
primary_objective: diagnose whether 0/24 occupancy floors and 24/24 ceilings prevent bounded contrasts, not rank budgets by maximal effect
admission: Report EVERY grid cell including all extinct or all alive, never select cells for confirmation
scientific_exclusions: does not quantify natural selection or fitness
